info.title: Leasefy Agent API
info.description:
Per-agency dashboard + onboarding API for the Leasefy cobranza autonomous agent service. AuthN = HS256 Bearer JWT with `agencyId` claim verified against `AGENT_JWT_SECRET`. AuthZ = `jwt.agencyId === :agencyId` path-param match (no cross-tenant reads).

---

## Async Event Channels

### cotizador/verdict.completed.v1

Emitted by the quote orchestrator (via redactAndEmit chokepoint) after every synchronous or streamed verdict. Consumed by cotizador-cost-aggregator and tenant-scoring-cotizador-recalibration Inngest functions.

**Payload (schema_version: '1.0'):**
- quote_id (UUID)
- tenant_id (UUID)
- cedula_hash (string — NEVER raw cédula, PII-redacted per G6/G7)
- verdict (approved | conditional | rejected | no_data)
- ranked_carriers (array)
- cohort_tags (array)
- degraded_carriers (array of {carrier, reason, since_iso})
- reasoning_trace_es (string — G6/G7 redacted)
- per_carrier_verdicts (object)
- schema_version ('1.0')
- timestamp (ISO-8601)

Breaking payload changes bump the topic to cotizador/verdict.completed.v2 per D-25-15.
This is an Inngest event, not an HTTP path — it does not appear in the paths object.

comprobante_url.description: Optional URL of the uploaded comprobante (receipt).

note.description: Optional free-text note recorded in the audit trail only.

action.description: approve → status="approved" + verified metadata; reject → restore prior status + audit note. ALWAYS human (T-323).

note.description: Required for reject (rejection reason); optional for approve. Recorded in the audit trail.

debtor_id.description: The debtor the abono is registered against.

amount.description: Partial payment (abono) amount, > 0. Persisted at Decimal(15,2) scale.

idempotency_key.description: Client-minted idempotency key (e.g. a UUID per button-press). A replay with the same key returns the original abono — no duplicate row.

payment_method.description: Optional human-readable method label (e.g. "transferencia", "efectivo"). Defaults to "manual_abono".

promise_id.description: Optional explicit PaymentPromise to link the abono to. When omitted, the most recent OPEN promise for the debtor (if any) is used.

note.description: Optional free-text note recorded in the audit trail only.

confirm.description: Must be true — explicit human confirmation that this payment was collected (T-323/Resolución SIC 2024). No automated path may register an abono.

channel.description: Channel used when contacted=true; null otherwise.

reason.description: Block reason when contacted=false (codeudor_disabled | no_fiador | no_fiador_contact | judicializado | schedule_blocked | frequency_cap | opted_out | channel_disabled | prohibited_copy | send_failed | feature_not_provisioned | debtor_not_found | empty_body). Null when contacted.

body.description: Already-composed, template-derived message body. The certified T-323 fence is a backstop, not the composer — pass approved template copy.
body.example: Buenas tardes. Le escribimos en su calidad de codeudor del contrato de arrendamiento. Comuníquese con nuestra oficina para ponerse al día.

phone.description: Operator-entered fiador phone (E.164, with or without +).

fiadorContact.description: Operator-entered fiador contact data. Required because there is no fiador-phone column in the schema; a human supplies it.

autonomyLevel.description: How much of the cobranza loop runs unattended. 'sugerir' / 'aprobar' require human approval before any outbound contact; 'automatico_controlado' / 'automatico_completo' auto-dispatch under the existing Ley 2300 / Habeas Data guardrails.

rowIndex.description: 0-based index of the failing row within the submitted batch.

truncado.description: True when the batch exceeded MAX_ROWS (2000) and was truncated.

format.description: Optional hint. JSON rows or CSV text. XLSX → export to CSV.

rows.description: Array of row objects keyed by header (cedula/nombre/telefono/email/monto/...).

csv.description: Raw CSV text (first line = header). Alternative to rows[].

CohortInsights.description: Phase 24 D-24-13/D-24-16 cohort-taxonomy match. null when no taxonomy row matched the candidate predicate OR when confidence < threshold (D-24-16). The field is ALWAYS present on the synchronous response and on the SSEFinalVerdict event (additive contract — Phase 22/23 byte-for-byte compat preserved otherwise).

DegradedCarrier.description: Carrier currently in degraded mode (D-25-09). Present in POST /api/cotizador/quote 200 response when ≥1 carrier is degraded.

degraded_carriers.description: Carriers currently in degraded mode (D-25-09). Present only when ≥1 carrier is degraded. Consumers that ignore unknown fields are unaffected (additive contract). Field is never in required[] — existing Phase 22/23 callers stay byte-for-byte compatible.

CotizadorQuoteResponse.description: Synchronous POST /api/cotizador/quote response (default — no stream). Phase 24 additively introduces cohort_insights; Phase 25 v1.1 additively introduces optional degraded_carriers. All other fields are byte-identical to Phase 23.

CotizadorErrorResponse.description: Standard error shape across the cotizador surface.

CotizadorQuoteRequest.description: POST /api/cotizador/quote body. cedula is HASHED at the server boundary (sha256(cedula | tenant_salt)) — raw cedula NEVER persisted (Habeas Data).

SSECarrierStart.description: SSE event `carrier.start`: emitted at fan-out start, once per carrier. The producer side writes the event to `cotizador_quote_stream_events` and the SSE wire atomically.

SSECarrierVerdict.description: SSE event `carrier.verdict`: emitted when a carrier returns a successful response (approved / conditional / rejected / error). prima_mensual_cop is non-null only when verdict === "approved".

SSECarrierError.description: SSE event `carrier.error`: emitted when a carrier dispatch fails (timeout, transport, parse). Structurally distinct from SSECarrierVerdict (D-24-05 mutual exclusion): error_code + retryable required, no verdict / prima_mensual_cop fields.

SSEPartialRanking.description: SSE event `agent.partial_ranking`: emitted once after the fan-out completes, before the final verdict + recovery + trace narration step. Carries the deterministic ranking + accepting count so the UI can render an interim view while the trace is being generated.

SSERecovery.description: SSE event `agent.recovery`: emitted on rejection before agent.final_verdict. type discriminates the payload shape (alt_path | counterfactual).

SSEFinalVerdict.description: SSE event `agent.final_verdict`: the TERMINAL event on the stream. D-24-02: reasoning_trace_es lives ONLY here. cohort_insights is the Phase 24 D-24-13/D-24-16 cohort match output (null when no taxonomy row matched or confidence below threshold).

SSEHeartbeat.description: SSE event `agent.heartbeat`: emitted every 5s during fan-out idle intervals so idle proxies do not disconnect. awaiting carries the set of carrier names still pending.

SSEEventPayload.description: Discriminated union over the 7 Phase 24 SSE event payload shapes. The SSE event type (carrier.start, carrier.verdict, carrier.error, agent.partial_ranking, agent.recovery, agent.final_verdict, agent.heartbeat) lives in the SSE `event:` field; this schema describes the payload (the SSE `data:` field).

QuoteVerdict.description: Aggregate verdict across all consulted carriers. mejor_opcion is null on full rejection.

CotizadorReQuoteResponse.description: POST /api/cotizador/quote/{id}/re-quote 200 response. delta_carriers + retained_carriers surface the D-24-11 selective re-run scope; session_cost_accumulator_usd reports the POST-increment value (D-24-20 session budget cap).

CotizadorReQuoteRequest.description: POST /api/cotizador/quote/{id}/re-quote body (D-24-09/D-24-11). PATCH semantics — at LEAST one of canon_mensual_cop, codeudores, tipo_inmueble must be present. Empty bodies return 400.

CohortTaxonomyRow.description: A single row of cotizador_cohort_taxonomy (D-24-13). matchPredicate is the JSON predicate (z-score range + categorical filters) the cohort evaluator matches against the candidate features.

CotizadorCohortTaxonomyResponse.description: GET /api/admin/cotizador/cohort-taxonomy 200 response. Ordered by cohortId ASC for deterministic consumption.

Phase25ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response shape for Phase 25 endpoints.

PolicyOutcomeRequest.description: POST /api/cotizador/policy-outcome body. source_actor is hardcoded server-side to "inmobiliaria_relay" — callers cannot forge carrier_direct source (D-25-02, T-25-05-03). observed_at is the caller-supplied event time; recorded_at is the server-side ingest time.

SlaMetric.description: Per-carrier, per-hour SLA metric row. Computed by the cotizador fan-out instrumentation (D-25-09).

CotizadorCostRow.description: Per-quote cost breakdown. Cost fields are serialized as strings in the actual response to preserve Decimal precision; this schema documents the numeric shape for codegen consumers (D-25-14).

breach_severity.description: null when no breach threshold is exceeded.

DriftReport.description: Drift report row: predicted vs observed outcome accuracy for a (tenant, carrier) pair over a computation window (D-25-12).

ArcoJobIdempotentEcho.description: 200 echo on idempotent replay (D-26-10 / T-26-06-03). Returned when Idempotency-Key matches an existing job for the same tenant. Original job_id returned.

ArcoJobAccepted.description: 202 Accepted response for ARCO action endpoints (D-26-10). The job is enqueued asynchronously via Inngest. Poll GET /api/cotizador/arco/jobs/{job_id} for status.

Arco503Response.description: Two-key counsel gate block (D-26-11). Returned when COTIZADOR_ARCO_ENABLED is unset or the compliance_acknowledgments ACK row is absent. Contact compliance@leasefy.co.

field.description: Field name to rectify. Must be in ARCO_RECTIFIABLE_FIELDS (consent_authorization_id, name_correction, address_correction). D-26-12: carrier verdicts, drift deltas, recalibration outcomes are NOT rectifiable.

ArcoRectifyRequest.description: Rectificación request body. Raw cédula keys (cedula, cedula_raw) are blocked at Zod refine (T-26-06-01).

ArcoCancelacionRequest.description: Cancelación body. Only tenant_id is required — the cedula_hash comes from the X-Cotizador-Data-Subject-Cedula-Hash header (T-26-06-01).

ArcoOposicionRequest.description: Oposición body. reason is optional — the data subject may omit it. Raw cédula keys are blocked (T-26-06-01).

ArcoJobStatus.description: Job status for GET /api/cotizador/arco/jobs/{job_id}. result_uri is a presigned S3 URL (24h TTL) for Acceso exports; null for other actions. error_message is non-null only on failed status.

get.summary: Acceso (Habeas Data Ley 1581/2012): enqueue an asynchronous export of all cotizador* rows associated with the data subject's cedula_hash. Returns 202 Accepted with a job_id; poll GET /api/cotizador/arco/jobs/{job_id} for the presigned S3 export URL (24h TTL). Two-key counsel gate (D-26-11).

schema.description: Cedula hash (path param — visual/routing only; auth via header).
Tenant UUID. Required — scopes the export to one inmobiliaria.
Required: 64-character lowercase sha256 hex digest of the data subject's cédula. Never the raw cédula (T-26-06-01 — raw cédula blocked at Zod refine layer). Format: /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/

200.description: Idempotent replay — existing job for this (cedula_hash, tenant_id) returned.

202.description: Acceso job enqueued. Poll status_url for the export URI.

400.description: Missing or malformed X-Cotizador-Data-Subject-Cedula-Hash header, or invalid tenant_id.

503.description: Two-key counsel gate not satisfied (D-26-11) or database unavailable.

post.summary: Rectificación (Habeas Data Ley 1581/2012): enqueue a correction of a cedula_hash-derived column. Only fields in ARCO_RECTIFIABLE_FIELDS may be corrected (D-26-12). Returns 202 Accepted. Idempotency-Key required (D-26-10).

schema.description: Cedula hash (path param).

400.description: Missing Idempotency-Key, malformed cedula_hash header, or invalid body.

503.description: Two-key counsel gate not satisfied or database unavailable.
